const getTVSymbol = (symbol) => TV_SYMBOL_MAP[symbol] || `BINANCE:${symbol}USDT`; /** * ── TradingView Chart Component (Iframe Method) ────────────────────────── * This is the most bulletproof way to embed TradingView. * No external scripts to inject, no React lifecycle collisions. */ function TradingViewChart({ symbol = 'BTC' }) { const tvSymbol = getTVSymbol(symbol); // Construct the secure iframe URL const embedUrl = new URL('https://s.tradingview.com/widgetembed/'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('symbol', tvSymbol); embedUrl.searchParams.set('interval', 'D'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('hidesidetoolbar', '0'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('symboledit', '1'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('saveimage', '1'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('toolbarbg', '04070d'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('theme', 'dark'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('style', '1'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('timezone', 'Etc/UTC'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('withdateranges', '1'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('studies', '[]'); // Pre-empty or add basic ones if needed embedUrl.searchParams.set('locale', 'en'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'localhost'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('utm_medium', 'widget'); embedUrl.searchParams.set('utm_campaign', 'chart'); return (
); } export default memo(TradingViewChart);
